mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM mq_subscribe WHERE topic_name = #{value}

SELECT id, name, class_name AS className, topic_name AS topicName, (select label from mq_topic x where x.name = topic_name) AS topicLabel, is_durable AS isDurable, description, is_active AS isActive, error, config AS configStr, server_id AS serverId, handler AS handler FROM mq_subscribe
order by id desc limit #{startNum}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, name, class_name AS className, topic_name AS topicName, is_durable AS isDurable, description, is_active AS isActive, error, config AS configStr, server_id AS serverId, handler AS handler FROM mq_subscribe WHERE name = #{value}

SELECT id, name, class_name AS className, topic_name AS topicName, is_durable AS isDurable, description, is_active AS isActive, error, config AS configStr, server_id AS serverId, handler AS handler FROM mq_subscribe WHERE id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_subscribe (id, name, class_name, topic_name, is_durable, description, is_active, error, config, server_id, handler) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{className}, #{topicName}, #{isDurable}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{error}, #{configStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{serverId}, #{handler})
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_subscribe SET class_name = #{className}, is_durable = #{isDurable}, description = #{description}, is_active = #{isActive}, error = #{error}, config = #{configStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}, server_id = #{serverId}, handler = #{handler}, topic_name = #{topicName}, name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
